 val photos: StateFlow<List<Image>> = _photos.asStateFlow()

 private val repository: ImageRepository

 init {
 val imageDao = ImageDatabase.getDatabase(application).imageDao()
 repository = ImageRepository(imageDao)
 loadPhotos()
 }

 viewModelScope.launch() {
 val images = repository.getImages()

 }
 }

 fun addPhoto(image: Image) {
 viewModelScope.launch() {
 val bitmap = ImageUtils.getBitmapFromUri(getApplication(), image.uri.toUri())
 if (bitmap != null) {
 ImageUtils.saveBitmapToInternalStorage(getApplication(), bitmap, image.title)
 }
 repository.insertImage(image)
 _photos.update { currentList -> currentList + image }
 }
 }

 fun deletePhoto(imageId: Int) {
 viewModelScope.launch() {
 repository.deleteImageById(imageId)
 _photos.update { it.filterNot { image -> image.id == imageId } }
 }
 }

 fun favoritePhoto(imageId: Int) {
 viewModelScope.launch {
 val newFavoriteStatus = _photos.value.find { it.id == imageId }?.isFavorite?.not() ?: false
 repository.updateImageFavoriteStatus(imageId, newFavoriteStatus)
 _photos.update { currentList ->
 currentList.map { image ->
 if (image.id == imageId) {
 image.copy(isFavorite = newFavoriteStatus)
 } else {
 image
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
